mapping_diagnosis.distinguishing_reason: The story faithfully maps the mechanism graph into a theater-backstage narrative without leaking any biology terms. All nodes and edges are covered with correct direction and relation type (is_a, enables, verifies). The turning point (skipping intermediate steps) effectively illustrates the necessity of sequential condition-process-result alignment. The only minor weakness is that node n2 (second transformation step) is less explicitly tied to the 'enables' relation from n1 compared to other edges, but it is still present. Compared to a possible realization that simply lists conditions as sequential steps, this story embeds the is_a relation (specific condition → general condition) and the verifies relation (experiment → condition) through character actions, making the mapping observably better.
